reviews.t: Nice color and coverage, and works great in Luminess Air
reviews.x: Love this stuff. I have a Luminess Air, and do not like their foundation - too expensive and they don't have the right color for me (all of them seem to be on the redder side). Aeroblend works great in my Luminess, the color is perfect, and it feels smooth - not cakey or moist (best word ever). It also applies much better than the Luminess foundation and lasts all day. You do have to shake that bottle pretty well to get all the pigment to mix. The color has just the right amount of blue in it so

reviews.t: Very Fine Pigment, Great Coverage & Staying Power
reviews.x: WOW. I've had my Dinair Airbrush (WORST Customer Service ever, btw) for about 3yrs now. I've used probably close to 10 different brands of airbrush makeup foundations, at all price points. This one goes on like a soft CLOUD of mist!! The color I bought, is too light--I'm mixing it with another product, but so far, it's wearing pretty well and I got really sweaty a few times, earlier today. No dryness or stickiness, either. Another plus, the amount is 1.1 oz. It's the most for my money, that I've

reviews.t: Double the product for half the price!
reviews.x: I was skeptical in buying this because some reviews said it seemed watered down and that it wasn't as good as Luminess Silk brand. Neither of those statements are true. This foundation is absolutely perfect and actually looks better on my skin than Luminess Silk! Not only that, but it's literally half the price and double the product! I will definitely be purchasing again!!

reviews.t: Fantastic product!!
reviews.x: I am 57 years old and I have tried probably every brand of foundation ever made! I have never left the house without it! I have always had redness and some irritation from most foundations. This is the most gentle stuff I have ever used! It gives my skin the perfect coverage, looks flawless after I airbrush it on! A few drops goes a long way! I wish this would have been around 40 years ago!

Since November, I have tried Luminess, Belloccio, and Aeroblend foundations. I had hoped I would like Belloccio because it's half the price, but it could not compare to the Aeroblend Foundation. Since using it the hyperpigmentation has actually gotten better. Who knew? The makeup goes on smooth and dewy and I love the blush. It’s all perfectly blended and looks so nice. reviews.t: It’s cakey and wipes off easily when a little perspiration
reviews.x: Don’t buy this. It’s cakey and wipes off easily when a little perspiration. Luminess is a much better product.

This product is a much bigger bottle than the Luminess, better opening (twist to open, no messy cap), and lasts longer-It takes half as much in the cup for the same or better coverage. I have 2 colors I blend together and the match is great! If you’re not happy with the luminess foundation try this, I think you

reviews.t: The best formula of airbrush makeup I’ve used.
reviews.x: The quality of this makeup is fantastic. I can do yard work and get sweaty and it stays put as long as I blot the sweat off and not wipe. It is water based so it is by no means waterproof but if you apply a setting powder over it helps it to stay. I’ve worn it in rain and it’s stayed pretty well. It lasts absolutely all day from 7am-11pm and is super easy to take off at the end of the day. My only issue with this product is, they don’t have a shade that matches my skin tone. I’m not olive nor pi

reviews.t: Somedays I look like I've suntanned for a week...
reviews.x: Need to shake a lot to get the right color - otherwise, it comes out too dark or too light and there's no way to tell until it's on the skin. Sometimes I look like I've suntanned for a week - other days ghostly pale. When I first got the airbrush, I thought the biggest problem would be cleaning out the tip - but that's a breeze - the difficult part is getting the color right. PS - it took me a while to get all the make-up on my face, and not my teeshirt.

(Didnt want to take pic, it was that bad)Lol. The second picture is the product i absolutely fell in love with- flawless .. i dont know what to think. reviews.t: Love the color and love the system - my makeup ...
reviews.x: I selected this color based on samples I received with my Aeroblend air brush system.  Love the color and love the system - my makeup never looks heavy.

reviews.t: Good value and great on pale skin
reviews.x: I bought the Aeroblend system and starter kit when I started airbrushing. I like the shade selection, but I've found some of the higher shades top match my Casper-like colouring. (I think the lower shades are meant for paler folks like me.) The pics I've posted show me with full makeup, and you can see how the shade matches my neck. I used O25 this morning. I usually switch between O20, but I knocked it on the floor. N25 offers more coverage, imo. I use it when I'm broken out

reviews.t: Best. Foundation. Ever.
reviews.x: This is the lightest, most long-wearing foundation I've ever used. Period. And with mature (52) skin which tends to be dry, I'm not left with unsightly creases at the end of the day either. I use the Aeroblend airbrush to apply this in the morning and it looks great literally all day long! Despite having sensitive skin, this makeup has not caused a single breakout to date. It also doesn't feel like I'm wearing a mask - goes on light and stays that way. Highly recommend.

reviews.t: Great coverage makeup, not so great container
reviews.x: The balls inside the container to help mix product when shaken are the same size as the opening in the top. I've had to unscrew the top and maneuver the stuck ball to be able to squeeze the makeup out. This can be annoying when in a hurry. As for the color, it matched perfectly and has flawless coverage. Great product but packaging needs a little fixing.

reviews.t: Terrible quality and overpriced
reviews.x: This make up is awful!  Very messy and clogged my airbrush machine.  Way overpriced too!  :(

reviews.t: Best Choice!
reviews.x: The best feeling makeup and stays put all day and all night.

reviews.t: Amazing for trouble skin!
reviews.x: This airbrush make up is very nice quality. This is the third bottle I’ve bought to use with my Aeroblend airbrush machine. I have very sensitive, acne-prone skin that suffers with hyperpigmentation as well. I love that I can build the coverage! I can keep it light in areas where less coverage is needed and build on very red and inflamed trouble areas. The product consistently sprays evenly as long as you shake it very well. Even with very heavy usage (2-3 air gun refills per use), this product

reviews.t: I really love this makeup
reviews.x: I really love this makeup. A bottle last a LONG time. You just have to make sure you clean your airbrush system EVERY time you use it. And always put the makeup on very lightly.....it takes a little longer but it comes out flawless. Then I wait a few minutes and set it with powder. I have tried probably 4 or 5 different brands with my Aeroblend machine.....and this is the only one that i really love.....I will not use anything else ever again.

reviews.t: I LOVE AEROBLEND!!
reviews.x: I LOVE AEROBLEND brand.... always pleased with coverage and quality. Works with ANY airbrush system in case anyone didn't realize that.  I get 2 colors because I am olive complexion I get O40 and O35 this takes me from summer to winter when I am matching my skin color! O40 I am a bit tan and add a drop or 2 of  O35 as fall and winter comes! Just 2 perfect matched colors to take me through my seasons of skin color! The best!

reviews.t: I bought the Aeroblend machine back in April and loved the sample of this color that came with it
reviews.x: I bought the Aeroblend machine back in April and loved the sample of this color that came with it.  I bought this, which cost a quarter of the cost of the machine, and it's watered down, doesn't hid blemishes, and isn't the same color...mostly it's just watery, you have to use twice as much to get it to cover and then it's "wet" for ages.  Don't waste your money.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the coverage and natural, smooth finish, often comparing it favorably to other airbrush brands.
Many reviewers say it outperforms Luminess and Dinair foundations in quality, value, and bottle design.
Several reviewers note the formula is gentle and improves skin, including reducing redness and hyperpigmentation.
A few reviewers report issues with color consistency, needing to shake well or receiving an off shade.
Some reviewers mention problems with staying power or packaging, such as cakiness, wiping off with sweat, or a confusing cap.
